findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to another tenant. This removes the function’s tenant-isolation check and creates a direct cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally, and the only prior-to-current delta changes src/labels.ts. The latest commit therefore does not restore the tenant comparison; the full PR diff still replaces userTenant === documentTenant with true.
